Progress and a re-scope. The **readers** are done on issue/586-app-stock-seam (gating): `prior_top`, `revolved_surface`, `columns_reach` and `carried_body_bounds` now read through `Columns`, and the answers are unchanged.

The **holders** can't move as a seam: they are the carried `Body` (sim `carry.rs`), a two-sided column store with lattice flips and mirrors that the app mutates (`simulate(&mut body.dex)`, `lower`). Putting that on the field engine is a data-model design, filed as **#637**. This PR will be `Refs #586`, and #586 closes when #637 lands.
partial on mkinney:issue/586-app-stock-seam · PR #642 (stacked on #595, Refs) · the readers; the holders wait on #637

For whoever picks this up after #781 (PR #831, merge-ready), notes from its review:
- **Cost after a flip:** cutting a carried field after a flip is about 35-40x dearer than upright. One slot on a 40×30 block takes 83-148 ms in release (2.4 ms upright) and 1.1-1.8 s in debug. The bake itself takes microseconds; a half turn about Z with no flip costs the same as upright. Budget for this, or pin the cost, before moving the holders onto the field engine.
- **Composing flips:** build composed turns with `CarriedField::then`, not by composing before `new()`, or the sticky `flipped` flag is lost (the unsafe direction for `floor_judged`). Also, `turn` is a pub field; a direct write would leave the flag stale. Consider making it read-only.

Research findings on `upstream/main` (`a277dd9d5`).

## 1. Open questions and answers

### Q1. Which parts of #586 already landed, and where does `Dexel` remain in `camcraft-app`?
Two PRs completed part of #586.
PR #642 moved four readers to `Columns` (`operation/top_stock.rs`, `operation/drill_prior.rs`, `operation/carried_stock.rs`, and `rest/across.rs`).
PR #1140 moved `stock_sim_carry.rs`, `rest.rs`, and `rest/across.rs::sweep` onto `Held` (`crates/app/src/stock_sim_held.rs`) and `CarriedStock` (`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/carried.rs`).
`Backend::Column` remains the shipped default.
Debug builds allow `CAMCRAFT_CARRY_ENGINE=field` (`crates/app/tests/carried_engine_agreement.rs`).

Production code in `crates/app/src/` still holds or names `Dexel` in three groups:
1. **Priors and masks:** `rest.rs` (`PriorState::grid`, `PriorPlan::simulate`), `rest/across.rs` (`carried_grid`, `carried_body_bounds`, `carried_stock_body`), `operation/drill_prior.rs` (`PriorCell`, `PriorRead`), `operation/top_stock.rs`, `operation/predrilled_entry.rs`, `operation/thread_entry.rs`, `operation/thread_r_plane.rs`, `operation/carried_stock.rs` (`Overhang::grid`), `operation/generate.rs`, and `operation/turning_rapids.rs`. (`operation/job.rs` names `Dexel` only in a comment.)
2. **Stock builder and `Held` seam:** `stock_sim.rs` (`stock_grid`, `simulate_document`), `stock_sim_held.rs` (`first_body`, `first_field`, `first_held`, `simulate_box`, `simulate_outline`, `clip_under`, `verdict_snapshot`, `verdict`, `into_tops`), and `stock_sim_carry.rs` (`clip_to_setup_stock`).
3. **Carried `Body` consumers:** `stock_sim_carry.rs` (`incoming_body`), `rest/across.rs` (`entered_body`), `rest/carried_cache.rs`, `fixture_carried.rs`, `setup_stock.rs`, `setup_stock_shell.rs`, and `setup_stock_view.rs`.

### Q2. How do operation priors and rest masks drop `Dexel` without changing verdicts?
Every prior and mask consumer in `crates/app/src/operation/` already reads only `&Columns<'_>` (`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/columns.rs`).
None of these callers mutate `Dexel` or read `Dexel`-specific fields.
Four modules also read `.cell`: `drill_prior.rs`, `thread_entry.rs`, `top_stock.rs`, and `carried_stock.rs`.
`Columns::cell()` already supplies that value.

Move `PriorState`, `PriorPlan::simulate`, `carried_grid`, `carried_body_bounds`, `carried_stock_body`, `Overhang`, and `PriorCell` from `Dexel` to `Stock`.
Pass `&Columns<'_>` (or `&Stock`) into `PriorRead`, `predrilled_entry::proved_holes`, `thread_entry::judge`, `thread_entry::judge_bosses`, and `thread_r_plane::judge`.
On `Backend::Column`, `Stock::Column` wraps the same `Dexel`.
Then `Stock::columns()` returns the exact same heights, and goldens stay identical.
Add `CarriedStock::into_tops_stock` in `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/carried.rs` so `camcraft-app` does not unpack `Body::dex`.
The `march::lattice_of` function (`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/march.rs`) snaps `SdfField` origins to multiples of `cell`.
In contrast, `stock_grid` places analytic stocks at exact world offsets (`docs/decisions/637-carried-stock-holders.md`).
`FieldBody::body()` preserves `FieldBody::lat`, so reading tops through `CarriedStock::into_tops_stock` keeps field-arm lattice alignment exact.

### Q3. How do `stock_grid`, `Held`, `credit_breaks`, and `credit_marks` drop `Dexel` from `camcraft-app`?
Move the remaining `Dexel` seams behind `Stock` and `CarriedStock` in `crates/sim`:
- **Stock construction (`crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs`, `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/backend_build.rs`):** Replace `stock_grid` with a builder that returns `Stock`. Add `Stock::from_shape_at` in `crates/sim` to apply `loc.pos` translation on both backends. Also compute the field lattice directly so `first_held` on `Backend::Field` allocates no temporary `Dexel`.
- **Clips (`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/carried.rs`, `carried_read.rs`):** Change `CarriedStock::clip_under`, `FieldBody::clip_under`, and `Ceiling::grid` from `Dexel` to `Stock`. Read clip heights through `Stock::columns()`.
- **Sinker burns (`crates/app/src/stock_sim_held.rs`, `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/`):** Move `simulate_box` and `simulate_outline` dispatch onto `Stock` and `CarriedStock` in `crates/sim`. Keep `ELECTRODE_FIELD_REFUSAL` on the field arm.
- **Verdict credits (`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/edge_break.rs`, `mark.rs`):** Change `credit_breaks` and `credit_marks` to take `&Stock`. Then `Held::verdict` returns `(Deviation, Stock)`, `Held::verdict_snapshot` passes `&Stock`, and `simulate_document` calls `display.surface(&classes)`.

### Q4. How do `Body`, cut-after-flip cost, `CarriedField::turn`, and #637 field gaps interact with #586?
- **`Body` in `camcraft-app`:** `RECOMMENDED.md` (#637 step D) keeps `carry::Body` as the read-back type until #589 retires the column engine. `fixture_carried.rs` and `setup_stock_shell.rs` read `body.dex` directly. `setup_stock_view.rs` calls `body.display().surface(...)`. Add `cell`, `nx`, `ny`, `origin`, `center`, `col`, `top_at`, and `surface` methods on `Body` in `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/carry.rs`. Then `camcraft-app` never names `Dexel`.
- **Cut-after-flip cost:** Comment 4 on #586 noted slow cuts after a flip on PR #831, which used `Stock::block`'s 10-span phantom floor. PR #1140 changed `FieldBody::block` (`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/carried.rs`) to build a closed `[floor, top]` box with no phantom floor (`docs/decisions/637-carried-stock-holders.md`). Measure and pin the post-PR-#1140 release timing before #589 flips the default.
- **`CarriedField::turn` visibility:** `CarriedField::turn` (`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/field_carry.rs`) is still `pub`. Make it private with a getter so callers compose turns only through `CarriedField::new` and `CarriedField::then` and keep `flipped` accurate.
- **Field gaps outside #586:** Cylinder carry (`FIELD_CARRY_SHAPE_REFUSAL` in `stock_sim_held.rs`), side-on carry (`FIELD_SIDE_CARRY_REFUSAL` in `carry_side.rs`), sinker electrode field atoms (`ELECTRODE_FIELD_REFUSAL`), and cut-through gouge depth stay in #637 and #589.

## 2. Design proposal (smallest useful slice first)

Keep `Backend::Column` as the default at every step.
All goldens, stamps, and agreement verdicts stay unchanged.

1. **Slice 1 (smallest useful first slice) — Operation priors and rest masks onto `Stock` and `Columns`:**
   Add `CarriedStock::into_tops_stock` in `crates/sim`.
   Move `rest::PriorState`, `rest::PriorPlan`, `rest/across.rs` bounds/grid helpers, `operation/drill_prior.rs`, `operation/top_stock.rs`, `operation/predrilled_entry.rs`, `operation/thread_entry.rs`, `operation/thread_r_plane.rs`, `operation/carried_stock.rs`, `operation/generate.rs`, and `operation/turning_rapids.rs` onto `Stock` and `&Columns<'_>`.
   Update test callers in `carried_engine_agreement.rs` and `tests/top_stock.rs`.

2. **Slice 2 — `stock_grid`, `Held`, and verdict credits onto `Stock`:**
   Add `Stock::from_shape_at`, `Stock::lattice`, `Stock::simulate_box`/`simulate_outline`, `CarriedStock::clip_under(&Stock)`, `credit_breaks(&Stock)`, and `credit_marks(&Stock)` in `crates/sim`.
   Remove `Dexel` from `stock_sim.rs`, `stock_sim_carry.rs`, and `stock_sim_held.rs`.
   Update test callers in `carried_fixture_side_exact.rs` and `setup_stock_source.rs`.

3. **Slice 3 — Encapsulate `Body::dex` and add the `camcraft-app` seam pin:**
   Add lattice, column, and `surface` methods on `carry::Body` in `crates/sim`.
   Update `fixture_carried.rs`, `setup_stock_shell.rs`, and `setup_stock_view.rs` to use those methods.
   Add `app_names_no_dexel_outside_tests` in `crates/app/tests/` (matching `crates/motion/tests/stock_seam.rs`).

4. **Slice 4 — Encapsulate `CarriedField::turn`:**
   Make `CarriedField::turn` private with a getter in `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/field_carry.rs`.

5. **Slice 5 — Pin cut-after-flip cost on `FieldBody`:**
   Measure release cut-after-flip wall time on `FieldBody::block` and add a budget check in `crates/sim/tests/`.

---

## 3. Proposed sub-issues (not filed because #586 is `P8` without `needs-research`)

1. **`M7.3: move app operation priors and rest masks from Dexel to Stock/Columns`**
   - Switch `rest`, `rest/across`, `operation/drill_prior`, `top_stock`, `predrilled_entry`, `thread_entry`, `thread_r_plane`, `carried_stock`, `generate`, and `turning_rapids` from `Dexel` to `Stock` and `Columns`.
   - Done means: No `Dexel` remains in `crates/app/src/rest.rs`, `crates/app/src/rest/across.rs`, or `crates/app/src/operation/` outside `#[cfg(test)]`; `carried_engine_agreement`, `top_stock`, and carried suites pass unchanged.
   - Proposed: `P6`, `effort:high`, `area:sim`.

2. **`M7.3: move stock_grid, Held clips/burns, and verdict credits onto Stock`**
   - Add `Stock` translation, clip, burn, and credit helpers in `crates/sim`, and remove `Dexel` from `stock_sim.rs`, `stock_sim_carry.rs`, and `stock_sim_held.rs`.
   - Done means: `stock_sim.rs`, `stock_sim_carry.rs`, and `stock_sim_held.rs` name no `Dexel` outside tests; `stock_engine_agreement`, `carried_engine_agreement`, `sinker_burn_held`, `setup_stock_source`, and `carried_fixture_side_exact` pass unchanged.
   - Proposed: `P6`, `effort:high`, `area:sim`.

3. **`M7.3: hide Body::dex behind accessors and enforce app no-Dexel seam test`**
   - Add `Body` column and `surface` methods in `crates/sim` for `fixture_carried`, `setup_stock_shell`, and `setup_stock_view`, and add `app_names_no_dexel_outside_tests`.
   - Done means: `crates/app/src/` names no `Dexel` outside tests (`app_names_no_dexel_outside_tests` passes), and `carried_fixture_*` and `setup_stock*` suites pass.
   - Proposed: `P6`, `effort:high`, `area:sim`.

4. **`sim: make CarriedField::turn read-only to protect sticky flipped state`**
   - Make `CarriedField::turn` private with a getter in `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/field_carry.rs` so callers use only `new` and `then`.
   - Done means: `CarriedField::turn` is private, all callers use the getter or `new`/`then`, and `field_carry` and `carry_engine_agreement` pass.
   - Proposed: `P7`, `effort:high`, `area:sim`.

5. **`perf(sim): benchmark and pin cut-after-flip FieldBody cost`**
   - Measure release cut-after-flip wall time on `FieldBody::block` and add a wall-time budget assertion in `crates/sim/tests/`.
   - Done means: A release test measures and asserts the cut-after-flip budget on `FieldBody::block`, and passes within budget.
   - Proposed: `P7`, `effort:high`, `area:sim`.
